mitigation: MFA; phishing-resistant admin auth; conditional access; recovery testing

mitigation: UUID/source sequence; idempotent load; reconciliation; dead-letter queue

mitigation: Security review; DPA; subprocessor and incident clauses; access review

mitigation: Daily dual control; duplicate/refund rules; exception escalation
